rationale: Twelve40minute lessons separate instrument/resolution reasoning,two light examples,two real TEM examples,functions,generalised comparison,concept maps,actual model construction,actual digital source work,claim audit and independent assessment. Captions distinguish prepared specialised tissue evidence from model assumptions. Final plant source is withheld in full;animal reuse is declared.

Distinguish an observation from an interpretation
Safe collaborative model and approved device use

Supply safe clean model materials and observe individual construction/contribution;drawings alone do not certify construction.
Approve source/device access and observe actual search,retrieval,save,credit and digital sharing;printed-only alternatives leave digital evidence not observed.
Confirm40minute pacing,individual access and practical/device capacity.

lesson_map.title: Does a bigger image always reveal more detail?
What can we actually see in an onion root light image?
Which cheek-cell labels are supported by a light image?
What does a genuine plant TEMsection show?
Is the animal TEMa whole generic cell?
Which component functions support a cell?
Can generalised plant and animal models allow exceptions?
How do cells connect to tissues,organs and organisms?
Can a made cell model explain a function and its limits?
Can we retrieve and credit an electron-cell claim?
Which cell-poster claims go beyond the evidence?
